verdict.rationale: Airwallex does not appear to have a built-in AI assistant embedded in its own web app UI; instead it ships 'AgentOS' — MCP servers and a CLI that let external AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) act on a user's production account (reading balances, creating beneficiaries, issuing cards, running workflows) with safety guardrails like no money-out by default. This satisfies the spirit of 'delegating financial tasks to AI' but via third-party agent connectors rather than a native in-product assistant. Missing for 10: evidence of a first-party chat/assistant UI inside the Airwallex dashboard itself, and independent user reports of using it to delegate tasks end-to-end.
